intro.title: Support long-term success
intro.paragraph: Competing with both brick-and-mortar neighbors and online retailers, today's businesses can't afford to choose a bad location. Innovative business leaders use location intelligence to forecast profits for potential locations and networks of locations and to make strong site selection and market planning decisions.

opportunities.title: See growth opportunities others can’t
opportunities.intro: Smart maps show current store performance or customer base in context of location and market opportunity. Spatial analysis enables selection of the most profitable sites based on competition, demographics, and supply chain.
bullets: Identify and target the most profitable locations.
Make repeatable growth decisions at scale.
Avoid cannibalizing sales and jeopardizing current business.
Optimize online buying and in-store customer engagement.
Make the most of store, market, and merchandise mixes.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.blurb: Empower data-driven site selection and territory planning with location intelligence from the Esri Geospatial Cloud.

items.title: Spatial Analysis and Data Science
items.body: Use location as the connective thread to uncover hidden patterns and trends. Create a competitive edge by integrating location into machine learning models and artificial intelligence.

items.title: Field Operations
items.body: Gain perspective on real-time field activities and use visually rich dashboards to inform decisions. See what can be accomplished through capturing accurate data and working in unison, easily navigating data and roads—even while offline.

items.title: Mapping
items.body: Visualize people, places, and assets to gain important insights into customers and competitors. See what's happening across a network of store locations, create strong business plans, and know where to allocate resources.

items.title: Market and Customer Analysis
items.body: Rely on data instead of guesswork to find your best customers, identify target markets, advertise strategically, and drive growth.

items.title: Supply Chain Digitization
items.body: Manage your supply chain digitally to find ways to increase efficiency, reliability, and customer satisfaction.

items.title: Logistics and Fulfillment
items.body: Organize complex delivery operations to ensure your supplies and products get to where they need to be in a timely manner.

items.title: Plan the Best Markets—Intuition Meets Data
items.excerpt: Data and intuition are a business leader’s boon companions, guiding decisions that can fuel company growth in the best possible markets.

items.title: Data-Driven Business: Avoiding the Pitfalls
items.excerpt: Learn how executives can use new tools to drive valuable business decisions, while avoiding the pitfalls of one-dimensional analysis.

items.title: Finding the Confidence to Grow a Business
items.excerpt: Retailer OXXO uses data to reveal the demographics and buying habits of local consumers.
